text:
Aisha: opened PR to sync export-playbook with structured-audit schema + add tiny SDK examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/613
Ben: Thx. Legal asked to avoid absolute retention claims. Use 'default retention period (e.g., 90 days)' and call out contract overrides.
Aisha: Updated wording to: 'Default retention periods are guidance; enforceable retention is determined by customer contract, compliance needs, applicable laws, and can be overridden on Dedicated/Private deployments.'
Taylor: We should have a compact Node streaming example and a short curl/paginated example. Keep long samples in 'Appendix'.
Sam: I'll add Go snippet + CLI showing `--redact=false` flag. Will show pagination with `--page-size=1000`.
Taylor: Node streaming sketch I added:
```js
// node streaming export
const s = await client.exports.stream({tenant:'acme', since:'2026-02-01', redact:true});
for await (const chunk of s) handle(chunk);
```
Legal: LGTM. Note: say 'tools for pseudonymization/redaction' rather than implying perfect redaction.
Aisha: Added pseudonymize helper example and swapped `user_id` to `user_ref` in JSON samples.
docs-bot: link-check found old internal URL in export-playbook.md -> 404
Sam: fixed to https://docs.redwood.com/export-playbook#guidelines and pushed commit 9b7c.
Ben: quick review done, applied tiny punctuation nit from Legal.
Aisha: Merged to main after docs CI passed. Closing.
